scenes.speaker: teacher
scenes.verbatim_quote: take your spot and move next to student a so you can move off your weak side
scenes.note: The teacher labels a location/student as a 'weak side,' framing students by a perceived deficit rather than by task or instructional need; it recurs and characterizes learners by their lacks.

scenes.speaker: teacher
scenes.verbatim_quote: you re still in the weak side and i don t want to put anybody else there
scenes.note: Repeated use of 'weak side' to designate students, framing them by perceived deficiency; treats a group/seat as a deficit category to be avoided.
